aggregation_notes: Postprocessed retained top50 only; zero increments conflate invalid/low-quality predictions and missing slots. Protocols use different NMS and physical evaluators; numerical differences are not isolated radius effects.
AP_top50 is the mean of precision@k over k=1..50 and four quality thresholds, not precision@50 or PR-AUC.
AP_top1 is a scene-level metric averaged over the same four thresholds; instance_Top1_Q20_at_0_4 remains a separate fixed-threshold per-instance statistic.
Each split contains 30 scenes and 256 views per scene. Split macro means are unweighted and equal frame weighting here because split sizes match.
Coverage is evaluated only in the postprocessed retained Top50; it is not coverage of all raw proposals.
At a fixed threshold, top1_good + good_in_retained50_but_not_top1 + no_good_in_retained50 equals 7680.
summary_difference records floating-point differences from the previously saved summary; no raw evaluator was rerun.

official.units: fraction; frame_count and scene_count are counts; mean_hit_count_by_k_at04 is a mean count
official.ranking: model q; official global NMS and per-object cap

r20.units: fraction; frame_count and scene_count are counts; mean_hit_count_by_k_at04 is a mean count
r20.evaluator: saved frozen project R20 physical values
r20.ranking: model q; saved project per-instance NMS then scene Top50

r20_rows_source.meaning: Legacy per-instance Top1 and collision/no-candidate rates remain separate from scene-level AP.

paper_inconsistencies.location: PDF page 5 / printed 4938, Section IV-B prose
paper_inconsistencies.issue: The prose names the slash-pair order Realsense/Kinect; Table I footnote explicitly gives Kinect/RealSense. This extraction follows Table I footnote; keep this discrepancy visible.

paper_inconsistencies.location: PDF page 7 / printed 4940, Table V vs accompanying prose
paper_inconsistencies.issue: The prose claims RGB-D improves both metrics, but novel Top-1 AP is 12.43 for Only Depth versus 11.83 for RGB-D.

uisn.baseline_source_policy: S1B in method_metrics.csv follows the original SuctionNet Table IV; do not replace its values with the slightly different Cao et al. row in UISN Table I.

baseline_camera_crosscheck.camera_order: Kinect/RealSense per Table I footnote; original baseline values confirm the camera association
baseline_camera_crosscheck.difference_interpretation: Some cells differ by 0.01 percentage points across the published tables; retain each source exactly.

uisn.macro_average_definition: Unweighted arithmetic mean across seen, similar, novel, calculated separately for each metric; no averaging of dissimilar metrics.

geometry_vs_network.meaning: Geometry scoring combines Normal STD with analytic wrench scoring, instance mean centroid and fixed camera-coordinate gravity (0,0,1). This is a full geometry-versus-network scoring comparison, not an isolated local-contact module ablation.
geometry_vs_network.camera_association: inferred from full-model values matching the RealSense UOIS-Net+UISN Table I row

uncertainty_modeling.meaning: Baseline is single MLP scoring; aleatoric adds variance head; epistemic applies test-time dropout; both combines them. Top-1 and threshold-specific ablation metrics are not reported.
uncertainty_modeling.camera_association: inferred from full-model values matching the RealSense UOIS-Net+UISN Table I row

mc_samples.hardware: Intel i7-10700 CPU + GeForce RTX 2070 GPU
mc_samples.meaning: Times are scoring prediction per scene, not necessarily complete segmentation and robot pipeline latency; default T=20.
mc_samples.camera_association: inferred from full-model values matching the RealSense UOIS-Net+UISN Table I row

input_mode.meaning: Only Depth keeps the architecture and uses all-ones initial features instead of RGB before voxel quantization. It is a closer input-modality comparison to depth-only E5, but does not isolate other model, segmentation, training and postprocessing differences. AP0.4 and AP0.8 are not reported for Only Depth.
input_mode.camera_association: inferred from full-model values matching the RealSense UOIS-Net+UISN Table I row

local_contact_module.meaning: No isolated local-contact module ablation appears in Tables II-V or Section IV-C. UISN predicts the combined suction score with one head rather than separate seal/wrench heads (PDF page 3 / printed 4936). Surface normals use a 1.5 cm neighborhood radius (PDF page 5 / printed 4938); this is approach-direction estimation, not an explicitly ablated suction-cup radius or local-contact scoring module.

comparison_limits: These are cross-paper numerical comparisons of E5 official R10 results and published UISN tables, not UISN reruns in the E5 evaluator.

UISN says it follows SuctionNet-1Billion evaluation with NMS and uses shared normals/collision detection for its own baselines (PDF pages 4-5). Table I baseline is the paper-reported Cao et al. [3] row; do not silently substitute another paper's rounded baseline numbers.
Do not combine per-metric maxima from UOIS-Net+UISN and UOAIS-Net+UISN as though they were one evaluated system.
Ablation sensor is not explicitly named in Tables II-V; their full-model values exactly match the RealSense UOIS-Net+UISN main-table row, so the association is inferred from equality.

development.meaning: Historical 10-scene x 32-view development validation; selected checkpoint steps differ. These are not E0-E4 complete official-test runs or isolated equal-budget module effects.

target_classification.meaning: Fixed historical planning commands associated with completed pick-and-transfer labels; not measured execution pose or policy success rate.
limitations: Validation records were used for checkpoint selection.
Labels concern historical planning commands and completed pick-and-transfer outcomes, not independently measured contact pose or new-policy robot success.
No complete fine-tuned public R10/R20 evaluation is supplied.

inference_efficiency.measurement: load includes file hashes, input geometry and observed normals; inference includes collation, transfer, model, output CPU transfer; total includes NMS/render, excludes final NPZ/JSON save and 3D viewer. Original cohort1139 vs stereo1158; not controlled paired benchmark.
inference_efficiency.comparison_limit: Different hardware and measurement boundaries prevent direct paper timing speedup claims; original and stereo cohorts are not paired.

rows.note: Parameter count from CPU architecture; checkpoint includes optimizer and training state, not inference-only weights. No forward pass or GPU use.
